beats.say: The team runs on AWS. Your last job was on another cloud.
beats.text: A cloud you do not know

beats.say: Senior loops assume you can build on any cloud. The ideas are the same.
beats.label: The good news
beats.head: Same ideas, other names

beats.say: Four areas: the data lake, access and network, code for infrastructure, and cost.
beats.label: Track 13 · Cloud and DevOps

check.prompt: Why is a rename of a big folder slow on S3?
options: S3 has no rename: it copies, then deletes
check.why: Object storage has no real folders. A rename is a copy and a delete of every object.

beats.say: First: the data lake on object storage.
S 3 stores objects under keys. It has no real folders.
beats.label: Object storage
beats.head: Objects and keys, no folders

beats.say: So a rename is a copy and a delete, for every object. On big data, that is slow.
beats.label: The trap
beats.head: Rename = copy + delete

beats.say: A catalog, like Glue, maps those files to tables. Then Athena or Spark can query them.
beats.label: Catalog
beats.head: The catalog turns files into tables

check.prompt: How should a job get access to a bucket?
options: A long-lived key in the code
check.why: A role gives short-lived credentials, and only the access the job needs.

beats.say: Second: who can read what?
Give a job a role, not a key. A role hands out short-lived credentials.
beats.label: Roles
beats.head: Roles, not keys

beats.say: And grant least privilege. Only this bucket. Only read.
beats.label: Least privilege
beats.head: Only what the job needs

beats.say: Keep traffic to storage on a private endpoint. It is safer, and it is cheaper.
beats.label: Network
beats.head: Private endpoints

beats.say: Third: no clicks in the console.
With Terraform, buckets, roles and clusters are code. You review them like any change.
beats.label: Terraform
beats.head: Infrastructure in code

beats.say: Docker packs a job with its libraries. So it runs the same way everywhere.
beats.label: Docker
beats.head: Same image, everywhere

beats.say: And a CI pipeline tests and ships each change. No one deploys by hand.
beats.label: CI/CD
beats.head: Tested, then shipped

beats.say: Last: why did the bill jump?
Look at three places first: compute that never stops, data that crosses regions, and old storage.
beats.label: Check first

beats.say: Quick recap of cloud and DevOps.
Object storage has no rename. Use roles, not keys. And keep infrastructure in code.
beats.label: Cloud and DevOps

beats.say: Now start the first lesson below.
